title: Apple Pie Pancakes with Maple Whipped Cream
changes_from_base: Grated apple macerated in brown sugar goes into a spiced batter, and the pancakes are topped with buttery cinnamon apples, maple whipped cream and pecans.
summary: Spiced pancakes with grated apple baked in, crowned with caramelised Fuji apples and a drift of maple cream—pure autumn comfort.
equipment: wire rack set in a rimmed baking tray
nonstick frying pan (30 cm) or griddle

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt
Golden Delicious apple, peeled and grated (about 1 medium)
Fuji apples, unpeeled, cut into 1.5 cm pieces
maple syrup, plus more to serve

steps.title: Stand grated apple
steps.text: Whisk 170 g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder, 1 tsp ground cinnamon, ¼ tsp fine salt, ¼ tsp bicarbonate of soda and ¼ tsp mixed spice. Toss 180 g peeled, grated Golden Delicious apple (1 medium) with 57 g light brown sugar and stand, stirring now and then, 20-30 min.

steps.title: Cook Fuji apples
steps.text: Melt 28 g unsalted butter over medium heat, add 270 g unpeeled Fuji apples (in 1.5 cm pieces), 42 g light brown sugar, ½ tsp ground cinnamon and ⅛ tsp mixed spice and cook, stirring often, until tender (10-15 min); off the heat stir in 60 ml maple syrup and keep covered and warm.

steps.title: Make maple cream
steps.text: Whip 240 ml double cream with 45 ml maple syrup to medium peaks (about 2 min); chill.

steps.title: Combine batter
steps.text: Whisk 1 large egg (room temperature), 120 ml whole milk (room temperature), 70 g soured cream (room temperature), 42 g unsalted butter (melted) and 1 tsp vanilla into the grated apple, add to the flour mix and stir until just combined.

steps.title: Cook
steps.text: Heat a griddle to medium (175 °C) or a pan over medium heat; scoop 80 ml portions and spread to 10 cm (1-2.5 cm apart). Cook until bubbles appear and the base is golden (2-4 min), lowering the heat if browning fast; flip and cook until cooked through (2-4 min); keep warm on a rack and repeat.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: Serve topped with the warm apples, maple cream, chopped toasted pecans and more maple syrup.

tips: Standing the grated apple with sugar for 20-30 min allows it to release moisture, which keeps the pancakes moist without making them soggy.
Two apple preparations—grated in the batter and cooked as a warm topping—give you apple flavour and texture in every bite.
Whipping the cream with maple syrup rather than sugar gives it a rounder, caramel-like sweetness that pairs beautifully with the spices.
storage: Best served fresh and warm. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
